Helio streams a computer's desktop and its games to another computer, inside one post-quantum WireGuard tunnel. It is one app for macOS, Windows and Linux: the client on every computer, and hosting as a switch in it, off until you turn it on.

**Best tested:** a Mac as the client, streaming a Windows host with an NVIDIA GPU and SudoVDA. [How far each system was checked](https://github.com/mihaicristianfarcas/helio/blob/v1.0.0/docs/verification.md), and [its known limitations](https://github.com/mihaicristianfarcas/helio/blob/v1.0.0/README.md#known-limitations).

## Install

Install Helio on both computers, the one to stream and the one you sit at.

- [Download it from the website](https://helio.mihaicristian.dev/#install), or take the files below.
- On a Mac, with Homebrew:
  ```sh
  brew tap mihaicristianfarcas/helio https://github.com/mihaicristianfarcas/helio
  brew install --cask helio
  ```
- [Build it from source](https://github.com/mihaicristianfarcas/helio/blob/v1.0.0/docs/install.md#building-from-source).

The macOS apps are notarized and the Windows programs are signed. Every file below has its signature beside it (`.minisig`): [how to check one](https://github.com/mihaicristianfarcas/helio/blob/v1.0.0/docs/install.md#from-the-website).

## What it does

- **Streaming:** HEVC or H.264, hardware encode and decode, HDR and YUV 4:4:4, loss repaired by reference invalidation, frame pacing at the client display's exact rate, stereo to 7.1 sound, controllers with rumble.
- **Post-quantum:** every packet travels in pq-boringtun (WireGuard with ML-KEM-768), and pairing is a hybrid SPAKE2 + ML-KEM PIN exchange.
- **A virtual display at the client's exact mode** on Windows, macOS and Linux (GNOME and KDE under Wayland) hosts.
- **From anywhere, without port forwarding:** hosts are found through sealed records on the BitTorrent DHT, and NATs are punched from both sides.
- **The clipboard, both ways:** text, images, files and folders.
- **Permissions per device:** whether it may see the screen, use the keyboard, mouse or controllers, copy and paste each way, start apps, take over or watch agents.
- **AI agents** can use your hosts as clients of their own, from Helio or from any MCP client, held to rules the host enforces.

[The README](https://github.com/mihaicristianfarcas/helio/blob/v1.0.0/README.md) has more, and [the benchmarks](https://github.com/mihaicristianfarcas/helio/blob/v1.0.0/docs/benchmarks.md) have the figures.
